name: DranSword
description: A high-speed Beyblade X top built for aggressive maneuvers, using its X-Celerator Rail-engaging bit to rocket forward at incredible speed for devastating collisions.

ability.name: Xtreme Dash (X-Dash)
ability.description: The Bit's gear engages with the X-Celerator Rail of a compatible stadium, causing DranSword to rocket forward at incredible speed for high-impact collisions.
